label: Stakovoutiro
note: Keeps for later; faint cheesy flavour; goes into Cretan pilaf (gamopilafo)

about.text: The fat that separates when Cretan cream is cooked into staka. It is kept as a butter with a faint cheesy flavour and used, above all, in the Cretan wedding rice, gamopilafo.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.text: Cream is cooked slowly with flour until the protein and the fat part ways.

steps.note: Salt and a little wheat flour or starch are added.
On a low flame with constant stirring for hours, until the protein and the fat part ways.
